entries.title: Hosea 9:1
segments: ¶Have no joy, O Israel, and do not be glad like the nations; for you have been untrue to your God; your desire has been for the loose woman's reward on every grain-floor.

entries.title: Hosea 9:2
segments: The grain-floor and the place where the grapes are crushed will not give them food; there will be no new wine for them.

entries.title: Hosea 9:3
segments: They will have no resting-place in the Lord's land, but Ephraim will go back to Egypt, and they will take unclean food in Assyria.

entries.title: Hosea 9:4
segments: They will give no wine offering to the Lord, they will not make offerings ready for him; their bread will be like the bread of those in sorrow; all who take it will be unclean, because their bread will be only for their desire, it will not come into the house of the Lord.

entries.title: Hosea 9:5
segments: What will you do on the day of worship, and on the day of the feast of the Lord?

entries.title: Hosea 9:6
segments: For see, they are going away into Assyria; Egypt will get them together, Memphis will be their last resting-place; their fair silver vessels will be covered over with field plants, and thorns will come up in their tents.

entries.title: Hosea 9:7
segments: ¶The days of punishment, the days of reward are come; Israel will be put to shame; the prophet is foolish, the man who has the spirit is off his head, because of your great sin.

entries.title: Hosea 9:8
segments: There is great hate against the watchman of Ephraim, the people of my God; as for the prophet, there is a net in all his ways, and hate in the house of his God.

entries.title: Hosea 9:9
segments: They have gone deep in evil as in the days of Gibeah; he will keep in mind their wrongdoing, he will give them punishment for their sins.

entries.title: Hosea 9:10
segments: I made discovery of Israel as of grapes in the waste land; I saw your fathers as the first-fruits of the fig-tree in her early fruit time; but they came to Baal-peor, and made themselves holy to the thing of shame, and became disgusting like that to which they gave their love.

entries.title: Hosea 9:11
segments: ¶As for Ephraim, their glory will go in flight like a bird: there will be no birth and no one with child and no giving of life.

entries.title: Hosea 9:12
segments: Even though their children have come to growth I will take them away, so that not a man will be there; for their evil-doing will be complete and they will be put to shame because of it.

entries.title: Hosea 9:13
segments: As I have seen a beast whose young have been taken from her, so Ephraim will give birth to children only for them to be put to death.

entries.title: Hosea 9:14
segments: O Lord, what will you give them? Give them bodies which may not give birth and breasts without milk.

entries.title: Hosea 9:15
segments: All their evil-doing is in Gilgal; there I had hate for them; because of their evil-doing I will send them out of my house; they will no longer be dear to me; all their rulers are uncontrolled.

entries.title: Hosea 9:16
segments: The rod has come on Ephraim, their root is dry, let them have no fruit; even though they give birth, I will put to death the dearest fruit of their bodies.

entries.title: Hosea 9:17
segments: My God will give them up because they did not give ear to him; they will be wandering among the nations.
